items.title: From insulin resistance to neurovascular breakdown: mTOR signaling as a convergence point in Alzheimer's disease.
items.authors: Chetiz Sharma; Mrinmoy Basak; Arpan Dhungel; Prakash Kishore Hazam; Trinayan Deka
items.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD), the leading cause of dementia, is increasingly recognized as a metabolic disorder characterized by disrupted insulin and insulin-like growth factor-1 signaling in the brain, a concept now referred to as type 3 diabetes. Central to this perspective is the insulin receptor substrate-1/phosphoinositide 3-kinase/protein kinase B/mechanistic target of rapamycin (IRS-1/PI3K/Akt/mTOR) cascade, which acts as the primary convergence point linking systemic insulin resistance to neurodegeneration. Impaired insulin signaling in astrocytes, neurons, microglia, and cerebral endothelial cells disrupts glucose metabolism, energy production, and amyloid-β (Aβ) clearance, while promoting tau hyperphosphorylation through glycogen synthase kinase-3β activation. Chronic mTOR hyperactivation exacerbates these dysfunctions by suppressing autophagy, impairing insulin sensitivity, and compromising blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity through tight junction disassembly, pericyte loss, and endothelial senescence. These processes collectively establish a self-perpetuating cycle of metabolic dysfunction, protein aggregation, neuroinflammation, and vascular breakdown. Neuron-derived extracellular vesicles have emerged as a promising non-invasive biomarker platform for monitoring central insulin resistance and therapeutic response in real time. Metabolically targeted interventions, including intranasal insulin, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, and mTOR inhibitors such as rapamycin, demonstrate encouraging preclinical and early clinical efficacy in restoring insulin sensitivity, reducing tau and Aβ pathology, and preserving BBB function. However, challenges related to delivery and dosing remain significant barriers to clinical translation. Continued investigation into neurovascular unit and multi-target combination therapies may facilitate the development of effective, biomarker-guided treatments for AD.

items.abstract_cn: 阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 是导致痴呆症的主要原因，人们越来越认识到这是一种代谢紊乱，其特征是大脑中胰岛素和胰岛素样生长因子 1 信号传导中断，这一概念现在被称为 3 型糖尿病。这一观点的核心是胰岛素受体底物 1/磷酸肌醇 3-激酶/蛋白激酶 B/雷帕霉素机械靶标 (IRS-1/PI3K/Akt/mTOR) 级联，它是连接全身胰岛素抵抗与神经变性的主要汇聚点。星形胶质细胞、神经元、小胶质细胞和脑内皮细胞中的胰岛素信号受损会破坏葡萄糖代谢、能量产生和淀粉样蛋白-β (Aβ) 清除，同时通过糖原合成酶激酶 3β 激活促进 tau 过度磷酸化。慢性 mTOR 过度激活会抑制自噬，损害胰岛素敏感性，并通过紧密连接解体、周细胞丢失和内皮衰老损害血脑屏障 (BBB) 完整性，从而加剧这些功能障碍。这些过程共同建立了代谢功能障碍、蛋白质聚集、神经炎症和血管破裂的自我延续循环。神经元衍生的细胞外囊泡已成为一种有前途的非侵入性生物标志物平台，用于实时监测中枢胰岛素抵抗和治疗反应。代谢靶向干预措施，包括鼻内胰岛素、胰高血糖素样肽 1 受体激动剂和雷帕霉素等 mTOR 抑制剂，在恢复胰岛素敏感性、减少 tau 和 Aβ 病理以及保留 BBB 功能方面表现出令人鼓舞的临床前和早期临床疗效。然而，与给药和剂量相关的挑战仍然是临床转化的重大障碍。对神经血管单元和多靶点联合疗法的持续研究可能有助于开发有效的、生物标志物引导的 AD 治疗方法。

items.title: Hypoxia preconditioning improves the anti-senescence potency of umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes.
items.journal: In vitro cellular & developmental biology. Animal
items.authors: Bardia Khandani; Fatemeh Bagheri; Somayeh Ebrahimi-Barough; Mehdi Kadivar
items.abstract: Over the past decades, mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) have gained enormous attention for their potency in regenerative medicine and the treatment of various diseases. However, the occurrence of replicative senescence, a phenomenon causing irreversible arrest in cell division, has not only hampered the achievement of the required dosage of stem cells for clinical use, but has also attenuated their therapeutic and regenerative potency. Previous reports indicated the capacity of biologically stem cell-derived exosomes to attenuate senescence-associated phenotypes, and numerous studies have shown that changes in physiological conditions, such as lowering oxygen levels, influence the components and effects of stem cell-derived exosomes. Thus, in this study, we investigated whether hypoxia preconditioning improves the senescence-attenuating potency of umbilical cord MSC-derived exosomes on replicative senescent of adipose-derived stem cells (ADSCs). Our results indicate that exosomes derived from hypoxia-preconditioned UC-MSCs exert greater ameliorative effects on senescence-associated phenotypes in ADSCs, demonstrated by SA-β-Gal, MTT, CFU, and flow cytometric cell cycle analyses. Furthermore, these effects are accompanied by decreased expression levels of P53, P16, and P21. These data highlight the importance of hypoxic culturing as an effective priming strategy for mesenchymal stem cells, enhancing the functional quality of their derived exosomes as potent agents to overcome the proliferative limits of MSCs, with promising applications in cell-based therapeutics.

items.title_cn: 缺氧预处理提高了脐带间充质干细胞来源的外泌体的抗衰老效力。
items.abstract_cn: 在过去的几十年里，间充质干细胞（MSC）因其在再生医学和各种疾病治疗中的功效而受到极大关注。然而，复制衰老（一种导致细胞分裂不可逆停滞的现象）的出现，不仅阻碍了干细胞达到临床使用所需剂量，而且还削弱了它们的治疗和再生效力。先前的报告表明，生物干细胞衍生的外泌体具有减弱衰老相关表型的能力，并且大量研究表明，生理条件的变化，例如降低氧气水平，会影响干细胞衍生的外泌体的成分和作用。因此，在这项研究中，我们研究了缺氧预处理是否可以改善脐带间充质干细胞来源的外泌体对脂肪来源干细胞（ADSC）复制性衰老的衰老减弱功效。我们的结果表明，SA-β-Gal、MTT、CFU 和流式细胞术细胞周期分析证明，源自缺氧预处理的 UC-MSC 的外泌体对 ADSC 中的衰老相关表型具有更大的改善作用。此外，这些效应还伴随着 P53、P16 和 P21 表达水平的降低。这些数据强调了低氧培养作为间充质干细胞有效启动策略的重要性，增强其衍生外泌体的功能质量，作为克服 MSC 增殖限制的有效药物，在基于细胞的治疗中具有广阔的应用前景。

items.title: Epigenetic control of microglial mitochondrial immunity by KAT7 drives Alzheimer's disease pathogenesis.
items.authors: Yongqing Liu; Yingzhi Ye; Minghua Fan; Henry Yi Cheng; Shuying Sun; Zhaozhu Qiu
items.abstract: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)-driven innate immune signaling sustains chronic neuroinflammation in neurological diseases such as Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet how this pathway is regulated in microglia remains poorly understood. Here, we identify the histone acetyltransferase KAT7 (HBO1) as a central epigenetic regulator that links chromatin remodeling to mitochondrial immune activation. KAT7 and its histone mark H3K14ac are elevated in microglia from 5×FAD mice and human AD brains. Integrative transcriptomic and epigenomic analyses reveal that KAT7 activates transcription of cytidine/uridine monophosphate kinase 2 (Cmpk2), a mitochondrial kinase essential for mtDNA synthesis. Loss of KAT7 reduces Cmpk2 expression, impairs mtDNA replication and release, and consequently suppresses cyclic guanosine monophosphate-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) and NLRP3 signaling. Importantly, both microglia-specific deletion and pharmacological inhibition of KAT7 mitigate cytosolic mtDNA-induced neuroinflammation, decrease β-amyloid burden, restore synaptic plasticity, and improve cognitive function in 5×FAD mice. Together, these findings uncover an epigenetic-mitochondrial axis sustaining microglial pathogenicity and establish KAT7 as a potential therapeutic target for AD.

items.abstract_cn: 线粒体 DNA (mtDNA) 驱动的先天免疫信号在阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 等神经系统疾病中维持慢性神经炎症，但小胶质细胞中如何调节该通路仍知之甚少。在这里，我们将组蛋白乙酰转移酶 KAT7 (HBO1) 确定为将染色质重塑与线粒体免疫激活联系起来的中心表观遗传调节因子。 KAT7 及其组蛋白标记 H3K14ac 在 5×FAD 小鼠和人类 AD 大脑的小胶质细胞中升高。综合转录组和表观基因组分析表明，KAT7 激活胞苷/尿苷单磷酸激酶 2 (Cmpk2) 的转录，Cmpk2 是 mtDNA 合成所必需的线粒体激酶。 KAT7 的缺失会降低 Cmpk2 的表达，损害 mtDNA 的复制和释放，从而抑制环鸟苷单磷酸-AMP 合酶 (cGAS)-干扰素基因 (STING) 的刺激物和 NLRP3 信号传导。重要的是，小胶质细胞特异性缺失和 KAT7 的药理学抑制均可减轻 5×FAD 小鼠胞质 mtDNA 诱导的神经炎症，减少 β-淀粉样蛋白负担，恢复突触可塑性并改善认知功能。总之，这些发现揭示了维持小胶质细胞致病性的表观遗传-线粒体轴，并将 KAT7 确立为 AD 的潜在治疗靶点。

items.title: Amyloid-β dimers bind to microglial TLR2 to induce early neuroinflammation and cognitive deficits in Alzheimer's disease.
items.authors: Yifei Liu; Kaiwen Tian; Kun Jiao; Na Wu; Kunhe Ma; Lingyun Shang; Miaomiao Du; Yujia Wang
items.abstract: Previous studies have shown that amyloid-β (Aβ) oligomers are implicated in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease (AD). Aβ oligomers include various molecules with distinct characteristics, such as dimers and trimers; among these, Aβ dimers have been found to possess neurotoxicity. This study found that Aβ dimers can induce microglial proliferation, enhanced phagocytosis, and pro-inflammatory polarization in the mouse brain even before cognitive impairment occurs, and this effect was validated in vitro using BV2 cells. Mechanistically, Aβ dimers bind to the microglial receptor TLR2, activating the downstream NF-κB signaling pathway and upregulating the expression of inflammatory factors. Knocking down TLR2 significantly reverses the Aβ dimer-induced inflammatory response and alleviates microglial-mediated neuronal damage. Furthermore, repeated intracerebral injections of Aβ dimers lead to impaired learning and memory in mice, as well as loss of hippocampal neurons and synapses; these changes are independent of amyloid plaque deposition and tau protein hyperphosphorylation. In summary, Aβ dimers induce early neuroinflammation and cognitive deficits by binding to TLR2 on microglia, providing a new molecular target for early intervention in AD.

items.abstract_cn: 先前的研究表明，淀粉样蛋白-β (Aβ) 寡聚体与阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 的发病机制有关。 Aβ寡聚体包括具有不同特征的各种分子，例如二聚体和三聚体；其中，Aβ二聚体被发现具有神经毒性。这项研究发现，即使在认知障碍发生之前，Aβ二聚体也可以诱导小鼠大脑中的小胶质细胞增殖、增强吞噬作用和促炎性极化，并且这种效应在体外使用 BV2 细胞得到了验证。从机制上讲，Aβ二聚体与小胶质细胞受体 TLR2 结合，激活下游 NF-κB 信号通路并上调炎症因子的表达。敲低 TLR2 可显着逆转 Aβ 二聚体诱导的炎症反应，并减轻小胶质细胞介导的神经元损伤。此外，反复脑内注射Aβ二聚体会导致小鼠学习和记忆受损，以及海马神经元和突触损失。这些变化与淀粉样斑块沉积和 tau 蛋白过度磷酸化无关。总之，Aβ二聚体通过与小胶质细胞上的TLR2结合诱导早期神经炎症和认知缺陷，为AD的早期干预提供了新的分子靶点。

items.title: Mitochondrial protein import stress augments α-synuclein aggregation and neural damage.
items.authors: Liam P Coyne; Arnav Rana; Xiaowen Wang; Joseph Mauro; Sanaea Bhagwagar; Yumiko Umino; Eduardo C Solessio; Frank Middleton
items.abstract: Genetic and environmental factors are known to converge on mitochondria to cause Parkinson's disease. The underlying mechanism is incompletely understood. In addition to bioenergetic defects, nonbioenergetic pathways have been largely unexplored. Validating the nonbioenergetic mitochondrial stressors as independent pathogenic factors is challenging because most mouse models of mitochondrial stress are confounded by bioenergetic defects. Here, we show that expression of Ant1P.A114P,A123D, previously shown to cause mitochondrial protein import clogging in cultured human cells, does not affect the overall bioenergetic capacity, yet it induces proteostatic stress responses in the cytosol that suggests accumulation of unimported precursor proteins. In a Parkinson's disease model expressing α-synuclein (A53T), Ant1P.A114P,A123D increased the size of α-synuclein aggregates, increased aggregation of mitochondrial preproteins, heightened neuroinflammation, and worsened motor coordination defects. Importantly, we found no evidence of bioenergetic defects in either α-synuclein (A53T) or α-synuclein (A53T) + Ant1P.A114P,A123D mice. These data suggest that Ant1P.A114P,A123D likely induces mitochondrial protein import stress, and contributes to neural damage through cytosolic proteostatic stress and altered aggregation dynamics of neuropathogenic proteins independent of bioenergetics.

items.abstract_cn: 众所周知，遗传和环境因素会聚集在线粒体上，导致帕金森病。其基本机制尚不完全清楚。除了生物能缺陷之外，非生物能途径在很大程度上尚未被探索。验证非生物能线粒体应激源作为独立的致病因素具有挑战性，因为大多数线粒体应激小鼠模型都被生物能缺陷所混淆。在这里，我们表明，Ant1P.A114P、A123D 的表达（之前已被证明会导致培养的人类细胞中线粒体蛋白输入堵塞）不会影响整体生物能能力，但它会在细胞质中诱导蛋白稳态应激反应，这表明未输入的前体蛋白的积累。在表达 α-突触核蛋白 (A53T) 的帕金森病模型中，Ant1P.A114P、A123D 增加了 α-突触核蛋白聚集体的大小，增加了线粒体前蛋白的聚集，加剧了神经炎症，并使运动协调缺陷恶化。重要的是，我们没有发现 α-突触核蛋白 (A53T) 或 α-突触核蛋白 (A53T) + Ant1P.A114P、A123D 小鼠存在生物能缺陷的证据。这些数据表明，Ant1P.A114P、A123D 可能诱导线粒体蛋白输入应激，并通过胞质蛋白稳态应激和改变独立于生物能量学的神经病原蛋白的聚集动力学导致神经损伤。

items.title: Single-cell profiling of the duodenum during chronic human norovirus infection.
items.authors: Yuki Matsushima; Jessica Durkee-Shock; Derron A Alves; Bianca M Nagata; Sun A Kim; Eunice C Chan; Natthawan Chaimongkol; Ryoka Ishiyama
items.abstract: Human noroviruses are a major cause of diarrheal disease, yet their pathogenesis remains poorly defined. We performed single-cell RNA sequencing of duodenal biopsies and matched stem cell-derived enteroids from immunodeficient individuals with chronic norovirus infection. Norovirus RNA was detected primarily in enterocytes, enteroendocrine cells, and macrophages, with the highest proportion of viral RNA-positive cells observed among M2 macrophages, followed by late enterocytes. Despite this distribution, late enterocytes produced higher viral yields than differentiated M2 macrophages in vitro. Norovirus infection was associated with the up-regulation of MHC class I-related genes and IL15 in duodenal macrophages and late enterocytes, together with increased IFNG expression by CD8 T cells. Macrophages and late enterocytes up-regulated CXCL9 and CXCL10/11, respectively, consistent with CD8 and CD4 T cell recruitment to the duodenum. These findings show that noroviruses infect and persist across multiple permissive cell types during chronic infection, resulting in marked dysregulation of innate and adaptive immune responses that may drive pathogenesis.

items.title_cn: 慢性人类诺如病毒感染期间十二指肠的单细胞分析。
items.abstract_cn: 人类诺如病毒是腹泻病的主要原因，但其发病机制仍不清楚。我们对十二指肠活检样本进行了单细胞 RNA 测序，并匹配了来自慢性诺如病毒感染的免疫缺陷个体的干细胞来源的肠样蛋白。诺如病毒RNA主要在肠上皮细胞、肠内分泌细胞和巨噬细胞中检测到，其中在M2巨噬细胞中观察到的病毒RNA阳性细胞比例最高，其次是晚期肠上皮细胞。尽管存在这种分布，晚期肠上皮细胞在体外产生的病毒产量比分化的 M2 巨噬细胞更高。诺如病毒感染与十二指肠巨噬细胞和晚期肠上皮细胞中 MHC I 类相关基因和 IL15 的上调以及 CD8 T 细胞 IFNG 表达的增加有关。巨噬细胞和晚期肠细胞分别上调 CXCL9 和 CXCL10/11，这与 CD8 和 CD4 T 细胞招募到十二指肠一致。这些发现表明，诺如病毒在慢性感染过程中感染并持续存在于多种允许的细胞类型中，导致先天性和适应性免疫反应的明显失调，从而可能驱动发病机制。

items.title: Mechanical forces enable human stem cell modeling of protein aggregation cardiomyopathy.
items.authors: Yasaman Kargar Gaz Kooh; Bahareh Bahmani; Chen Zhao; Ganesh Malayath; Anastasia Khokhlova; Leah Hayem; Hertier Umuragwa; Hanxun Jin
items.abstract: Inherited cardiomyopathies are the leading cause of heart failure in young adults, with limited therapeutic options. Desmin-related cardiomyopathy (DRM), caused by mutations to cytoskeletal proteins and their chaperones, exemplifies this challenge: Here, protein quality control is compromised, leading to toxic protein aggregates that destroy cardiomyocyte contractile machinery. One of the deadliest DRM mutations in the chaperone protein αB crystallin (CRYAB-R120G) lacks a genetically matched preclinical model: Mouse models require massive overexpression of mutant CRYAB, raising questions about physiological relevance. Here, we establish a human model of CRYAB-linked DRM, using induced pluripotent stem cells expressing CRYAB-R120G at near-endogenous levels. We show that three-dimensional mechanical loading, but not fatty acid-based metabolic maturation media, is essential for expressing Desmin, whose aggregation defines DRM. Using microengineered heart tissues, we found that contractile deficits are associated with impaired calcium handling, pointing to electromechanical uncoupling in DRM. Treatment with the Janus kinase 1 inhibitor itacitinib partially rescued contractility, providing a functional validation of this emerging therapeutic strategy.

items.abstract_cn: 遗传性心肌病是年轻人心力衰竭的主要原因，治疗选择有限。由细胞骨架蛋白及其分子伴侣突变引起的结蛋白相关心肌病 (DRM) 就是这一挑战的例证：蛋白质质量控​​制受到损害，导致有毒蛋白质聚集体破坏心肌细胞收缩机制。伴侣蛋白 αB 晶状体蛋白 (CRYAB-R120G) 中最致命的 DRM 突变之一缺乏基因匹配的临床前模型：小鼠模型需要突变体 CRYAB 的大量过度表达，这引发了有关生理相关性的问题。在这里，我们使用以接近内源水平表达 CRYAB-R120G 的诱导多能干细胞建立了 CRYAB 连接 DRM 的人类模型。我们表明，三维机械负荷，而不是基于脂肪酸的代谢成熟培养基，对于表达结蛋白至关重要，结蛋白的聚集定义了 DRM。使用微工程心脏组织，我们发现收缩缺陷与钙处理受损有关，这表明 DRM 中存在机电解耦。 Janus 激酶 1 抑制剂 itacitinib 治疗部分挽救了收缩性，为这一新兴治疗策略提供了功能验证。

items.title: TREM2
items.authors: Ming Yuan; Xue Jiao; Le Xu; Qianhui Ren; Shuang Wang; Zhaoyang Zhong; Na Li; Qiuju Li
items.abstract: Macrophages are the most abundant immune cells in endometriotic lesions, but the roles of specific macrophage subsets in local immune dysfunction remain poorly understood. Here, combining single-cell RNA sequencing of 11 clinical samples with TREM2 knockout mouse models, co-culture experiments, and pharmacological intervention, we identify TREM2+ macrophages as an immunoregulatory population enriched in endometriosis. CD8+ T and natural killer (NK) cells in endometriotic lesions exhibited exhaustion-associated features and reduced cytotoxicity. Cell-cell communication analysis and functional experiments revealed that TREM2+ macrophages regulated CD8+ T cell activity through SPP1-CD44-associated communication and BAG3-associated autophagy regulation. In a mouse model of endometriosis, TREM2 deficiency enhanced CD8+ T and NK cell cytotoxicity and reduced ectopic lesion growth. Pharmacological disruption of the BAG3-HSP70 interaction with YM-1 impaired CD8+ T cell function and promoted lesion growth, and BAG3 silencing reduced autophagy-related markers and effector function in CD8+ T cells, supporting the involvement of BAG3-associated regulation in TREM2+ macrophage-mediated immune dysfunction. Our data identify TREM2+ macrophages as important regulators of immune dysregulation in endometriosis and highlight TREM2 as a potential target for future non-hormonal therapeutic strategies.

items.title: Spatial evolution of microglial phenotypes and iron accumulation in CSF1R-associated leukoencephalopathy.
items.authors: Julia Lier; Alireza Moein; Alonso Barrantes-Freer; Dennis-Dominik Rosmus; Markus Ponleitner; Jonas Franz; Ute Römuß; Evgeniya Kirilina
items.abstract: Colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor (CSF1R)-associated leukoencephalopathy (CSF1R-LE) is a fatal genetic white matter disease, whose onset is most commonly in mid-age adulthood, and is characterized by rapid neurological decline and premature death within a few years after disease onset. CSF1R is exclusively expressed by microglia in the parenchyma of the adult central nervous system, thus defining CSF1R-LE as a paradigmatic primary microgliopathy. However, the cellular alterations that drive the sudden onset and rapid progression of the disease remain largely unknown. Therefore, the investigation of microglia phenotypes in human histopathological tissue, particularly considering the spatial evolution of the pathology, can provide crucial insights into the disease-causing mechanisms. In this study, we (immuno-) histochemically characterized myeloid cell pathology in relation to the extent of damage to the axon-myelin unit in five autopsy cases of CSF1R-LE. A particular focus was on the relationship between microglia phenotypes and the pronounced iron accumulation observed in this disease. Our findings provide evidence that the early loss of homeostatic microglia and inflammatory activation of remaining myeloid cells are key components of areas with mild tissue pathology. Furthermore, we demonstrate a marked and progressive accumulation of iron within myeloid cells paralleling increasing white matter damage. This process is associated with ongoing myelin degeneration and occurs in the apparent absence of efficient remyelination. In summary, our study reveals stage-specific myeloid cell pathology in CSF1R-LE and highlights a specific spatial heterogeneity that should be considered when studying this disease. Moreover, our findings suggest that cellular iron accumulation may not only contribute to disease progression but may also represent a promising and clinically accessible biomarker for CSF1R-LE.

items.abstract_cn: 集落刺激因子1受体（CSF1R）相关白质脑病（CSF1R-LE）是一种致命的遗传性白质疾病，其发病最常见于中年，其特点是神经功能迅速衰退，并在发病后几年内过早死亡。 CSF1R 仅由成人中枢神经系统实质中的小胶质细胞表达，因此将 CSF1R-LE 定义为典型的原发性小胶质细胞病。然而，导致疾病突然发作和快速进展的细胞改变仍然很大程度上未知。因此，对人类组织病理学组织中小胶质细胞表型的研究，特别是考虑病理学的空间进化，可以为致病机制提供重要的见解。在这项研究中，我们对五例 CSF1R-LE 尸检病例中的轴突髓磷脂单位损伤程度进行了（免疫）组织化学表征。特别关注的是小胶质细胞表型与在这种疾病中观察到的明显铁积累之间的关系。我们的研究结果证明，小胶质细胞稳态的早期丧失和剩余骨髓细胞的炎症激活是具有轻度组织病理学区域的关键组成部分。此外，我们证明了骨髓细胞内铁的显着且渐进的积累，同时白质损伤也随之增加。这一过程与持续的髓鞘变性有关，并且在明显缺乏有效的髓鞘再生的情况下发生。总之，我们的研究揭示了 CSF1R-LE 中特定阶段的骨髓细胞病理学，并强调了研究这种疾病时应考虑的特定空间异质性。此外，我们的研究结果表明，细胞铁积累不仅可能导致疾病进展，而且还可能代表 CSF1R-LE 的一种有前途且临床可用的生物标志物。

items.title: The blood-brain barrier imports diverse neuroprotective proteins through pathways impaired early in Alzheimer's disease models.
items.authors: Haoyue Zhou; Jason C Maynard; Alexander J Pennacchio; Amanda Apolonio; Xi Liu; Lei Yao; Mina Negahban; Zimo Zhang
items.abstract: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) has been defined primarily by what it excludes, yet the scale and function of physiological blood-to-brain protein transport remain largely unknown. Using bioorthogonal proteomics, we find that the healthy BBB samples 191 plasma proteins and permits 92 into the brain parenchyma. Enriched for carrier and metabolic functions, these proteins home to distinct brain cell types, such as apolipoprotein A1 (APOA1) to astrocytes and alpha-1 antitrypsin (SERPINA1) to microglia. This cell-type tropism relies on a BBB-parenchyma receptor hand-off: APOA1 crosses the BBB via SR-B1 and engages astrocytic ATP-binding cassette transporter A1 (ABCA1), a key Alzheimer's risk gene, driving cholesterol efflux that supports synapse integrity. Unlike LPS-induced nonspecific leakage, early-stage 5xFAD mice show selective BBB transport remodeling, with reduced APOA1 and increased SERPINA1 uptake. Hepatic APOA1 overexpression restores APOA1 in the 5xFAD brain, rescuing astrocytic, synaptic, and behavioral deficits. These findings recast the BBB as a selective interface that recruits neuroprotective circulatory proteins for brain health.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Epigenetic control of microglial mitochondrial immunity by KAT7 drives Alzheimer's disease pathogenesis.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Yongqing Liu; Yingzhi Ye; Minghua Fan; Henry Yi Cheng; Shuying Sun; Zhaozhu Qiu
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)-driven innate immune signaling sustains chronic neuroinflammation in neurological diseases such as Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet how this pathway is regulated in microglia remains poorly understood. Here, we identify the histone acetyltransferase KAT7 (HBO1) as a central epigenetic regulator that links chromatin remodeling to mitochondrial immune activation. KAT7 and its histone mark H3K14ac are elevated in microglia from 5×FAD mice and human AD brains. Integrative transcriptomic and epigenomic analyses reveal that KAT7 activates transcription of cytidine/uridine monophosphate kinase 2 (Cmpk2), a mitochondrial kinase essential for mtDNA synthesis. Loss of KAT7 reduces Cmpk2 expression, impairs mtDNA replication and release, and consequently suppresses cyclic guanosine monophosphate-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) and NLRP3 signaling. Importantly, both microglia-specific deletion and pharmacological inhibition of KAT7 mitigate cytosolic mtDNA-induced neuroinflammation, decrease β-amyloid burden, restore synaptic plasticity, and improve cognitive function in 5×FAD mice. Together, these findings uncover an epigenetic-mitochondrial axis sustaining microglial pathogenicity and establish KAT7 as a potential therapeutic target for AD.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 线粒体 DNA (mtDNA) 驱动的先天免疫信号在阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 等神经系统疾病中维持慢性神经炎症，但小胶质细胞中如何调节该通路仍知之甚少。在这里，我们将组蛋白乙酰转移酶 KAT7 (HBO1) 确定为将染色质重塑与线粒体免疫激活联系起来的中心表观遗传调节因子。 KAT7 及其组蛋白标记 H3K14ac 在 5×FAD 小鼠和人类 AD 大脑的小胶质细胞中升高。综合转录组和表观基因组分析表明，KAT7 激活胞苷/尿苷单磷酸激酶 2 (Cmpk2) 的转录，Cmpk2 是 mtDNA 合成所必需的线粒体激酶。 KAT7 的缺失会降低 Cmpk2 的表达，损害 mtDNA 的复制和释放，从而抑制环鸟苷单磷酸-AMP 合酶 (cGAS)-干扰素基因 (STING) 的刺激物和 NLRP3 信号传导。重要的是，小胶质细胞特异性缺失和 KAT7 的药理学抑制均可减轻 5×FAD 小鼠胞质 mtDNA 诱导的神经炎症，减少 β-淀粉样蛋白负担，恢复突触可塑性并改善认知功能。总之，这些发现揭示了维持小胶质细胞致病性的表观遗传-线粒体轴，并将 KAT7 确立为 AD 的潜在治疗靶点。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Glial progenitor-like state is preferentially co-opted in glioblastoma and sustained by POU3F3.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Susana I Ramos; Mohammad Imran K Khan; Wan Sze Cheng; Balagopal Pai; Thenzing J Silva-Hurtado; Jorge Samanamud; Xi Chen; Kristin G Beaumont
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Oncofetal reprogramming in glioblastoma (GBM) relies on the co-option of still poorly defined pathways that are transiently active during brain development, thereby exposing therapeutically actionable vulnerabilities. To better characterize GBM biology in the context of neurodevelopment, we create an expanded human spatiotemporal multi-omic dataset that resolves both gliogenic and neurogenic lineage fate and assess oncofetal reprogramming at the tumor core and infiltrative margin in both primary and recurrent disease. Analyses reveal the preferential enrichment of a glial intermediate progenitor cell (gIPC)-like state, which is most reminiscent of third-trimester germinal matrix gIPCs, across tumor regions and in recurrence. We uncover EGFR and the long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) NRXN1-DT as co-opted gIPC-specific markers, demonstrate NRXN1-DT's clinical utility in GBM diagnostics, and prioritize POU3F3 as a gIPC-like oncofetal driver, confirming its regulatory role in NRXN1-DT enhancer activity, EGFR expression, and maintenance of GBM stem/progenitor-like properties. This study lays the groundwork for future investigations into targeting POU3F3 and other co-opted gliogenic drivers as GBM therapeutics.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: The blood-brain barrier imports diverse neuroprotective proteins through pathways impaired early in Alzheimer's disease models.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Haoyue Zhou; Jason C Maynard; Alexander J Pennacchio; Amanda Apolonio; Xi Liu; Lei Yao; Mina Negahban; Zimo Zhang
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) has been defined primarily by what it excludes, yet the scale and function of physiological blood-to-brain protein transport remain largely unknown. Using bioorthogonal proteomics, we find that the healthy BBB samples 191 plasma proteins and permits 92 into the brain parenchyma. Enriched for carrier and metabolic functions, these proteins home to distinct brain cell types, such as apolipoprotein A1 (APOA1) to astrocytes and alpha-1 antitrypsin (SERPINA1) to microglia. This cell-type tropism relies on a BBB-parenchyma receptor hand-off: APOA1 crosses the BBB via SR-B1 and engages astrocytic ATP-binding cassette transporter A1 (ABCA1), a key Alzheimer's risk gene, driving cholesterol efflux that supports synapse integrity. Unlike LPS-induced nonspecific leakage, early-stage 5xFAD mice show selective BBB transport remodeling, with reduced APOA1 and increased SERPINA1 uptake. Hepatic APOA1 overexpression restores APOA1 in the 5xFAD brain, rescuing astrocytic, synaptic, and behavioral deficits. These findings recast the BBB as a selective interface that recruits neuroprotective circulatory proteins for brain health.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Measles-like hypermutation of a Newcastle disease virus drives fatal encephalitis during BCMA × CD3 T-cell-redirecting immunotherapy.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Christina Krueger; Christoph Schaefers; Thomas Guenther; Lisa Leypoldt; Ricardo Ahrens; Winfried Alsdorf; Maximilian Al-Bazaz; Katja Weisel
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Newcastle disease virus (NDV or AOaV-1) is an avian paramyxovirus that typically causes only mild, self-limiting disease in humans. Here, we report fatal neuroinvasive AOaV-1 infection in a patient with multiple myeloma receiving maintenance therapy with teclistamab, daratumumab, and lenalidomide following frontline teclistamab-based treatment and autologous stem cell transplantation. Following rapidly progressive brainstem-cerebellar encephalitis and negative conventional microbiological testing, unbiased metagenomic RNA sequencing of a cerebellar biopsy identified AOaV-1 at high intraparenchymal abundance. Viral genome analysis revealed striking A-to-G and U-to-C substitutions selectively concentrated in the matrix gene, consistent with ADAR-mediated RNA editing. Long-read sequencing resolved two genetically distinct, independently hypermutated CNS haplotypes. Post-mortem analysis demonstrated widespread dissemination and continued viral diversification in multiple brain regions, whereas a peripheral urine sample contained a minimally mutated putative ancestral lineage. These findings support peripheral infection followed by CNS seeding and compartmentalized within-host evolution. The selective matrix-gene hypermutation closely parallels persistent measles virus infection in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis, revealing a shared mechanism of paramyxovirus adaptation to the CNS. Profound immunotherapy-associated immune dysfunction may thus create niches enabling normally low-pathogenic zoonotic viruses to persist, evolve, and acquire severe neurovirulence.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 新城疫病毒（NDV 或 AOaV-1）是一种禽副粘病毒，通常仅引起人类轻微的自限性疾病。在这里，我们报告了一名多发性骨髓瘤患者在接受基于 teclistamab 的一线治疗和自体干细胞移植后接受 teclistamab、达雷妥尤单抗和来那度胺维持治疗的致命性神经侵袭性 AOaV-1 感染。在快速进展的脑干小脑脑炎和常规微生物检测阴性后，小脑活检的无偏宏基因组 RNA 测序鉴定出脑实质内高丰度的 AOaV-1。病毒基因组分析显示，显着的 A 至 G 和 U 至 C 取代选择性集中在基质基因中，这与 ADAR 介导的 RNA 编辑一致。长读长测序解析了两种遗传上不同、独立超突变的 CNS 单倍型。尸检分析表明，病毒在多个大脑区域广泛传播和持续多样化，而外周尿液样本中含有最低限度突变的假定祖先谱系。这些发现支持外周感染，随后是中枢神经系统播种和宿主内分化的进化。选择性基质基因超突变与亚急性硬化性全脑炎中持续性麻疹病毒感染密切相关，揭示了副粘病毒适应中枢神经系统的共同机制。因此，与免疫治疗相关的严重免疫功能障碍可能会创造一个生态位，使通常低致病性的人畜共患病毒能够持续存在、进化并获得严重的神经毒力。

top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Haoran Zhang; Zhen Liu; Bijia Chen; Guangxin Zhang; Longteng Wang; Changsheng Wei; Xiaohui Zhang; Yuxiang Luo
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Microglia are brain-resident immune cells with complex physiological functions. Exploring their proteomic heterogeneity at the single-cell level has remained technically challenging. top_journal_neuroscience.title: The genetic landscape of canine tumors: Insights from the Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA).
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Eugenio Mazzone; Laura Marconato; Antonella Fanelli; Luciano Cascione; Francesco Bertoni; Caterina Marchiò; Anna Sapino; Luca Aresu
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: The Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA, https://caninecancergenomeatlas.org/) is an open, accessible comparative oncology resource that harmonizes whole-exome data across 10 canine tumor histotypes. It aggregates 667 tumor-normal pairs with curated single-nucleotide variants, insertions and deletions, structural variants, and copy number aberrations. Cohort-depth stratification distinguished primary, exploratory, and descriptive analyses. Selection analyses identified 39 cancer drivers, including recurrent TP53, PIK3CA, PTEN, SETD2, MAP3K14, and FAT4 alterations; copy number events included MYC amplifications and PTEN deletions. Direct comparison with matched human cancers revealed conserved and species-enriched oncogenic mechanisms, pathways, and therapeutic contexts. The CCGA standardizes alignment, variant calling, and annotation through consensus pipelines and provides downloadable data and interactive analyses. This reusable framework advances precision veterinary oncology and strengthens translational bridges to human cancer, supporting comparative and translational research.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Insight discordance differentiates behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia from false positives.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Joshua Flavell; Soohyun Lee; Caitlin A T McElligott; Felicia M Coleman; Amir Fazlollahi; Peter J Nestor
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) can present with behavioural symptoms similar to psychiatric mimics of the disease (sometimes termed 'phenocopies'). Despite this overlap, loss of insight is a cardinal feature of bvFTD unlike most psychiatric disorders. This study tested whether insight could be quantified to improve diagnostic accuracy in distinguishing these conditions, and examined neuroimaging correlates of impaired insight. In this prospective cohort study, 27 patients with frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD) presenting as the bvFTD phenotype and 25 false-positives of bvFTD who ultimately had a psychiatric disorder underwent patient, informant, and clinician symptom ratings on a modified Frontal Behavioural Inventory (FBI). Discrepancy scores were calculated, diagnostic discrimination was evaluated by area under the curve (AUC) with leave-one-out cross-validation, alongside a neuroimaging analysis of network-level associations of insight in bvFTD. Patients with bvFTD endorsed fewer symptoms than false-positives (FBI 6.62 ± 8.80 vs 15.36 ± 8.42, P < 0.001), whereas clinician observations were markedly greater in bvFTD (27.67 ± 8.35 vs 5.64 ± 3.85, P < 0.001). Informant ratings did not differ between groups (25.15 ± 11.11 vs 21.32 ± 12.61, P = 0.14), even though bvFTD informants had more knowledge of the disease (FTD Knowledge Scale 16.20 ± 6.68 vs 9.41 ± 8.19, P = 0.003). A model incorporating patient-clinician and informant-clinician discrepancy showed excellent cross-validated discrimination (AUC 0.99, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.97-1.00). A model independent of expert clinician ratings, the patient-informant discrepancy, showed fair cross-validated discrimination across the full cohort (AUC 0.71, 95% CI 0.56-0.85) and good discrimination in those who did not develop another FTLD syndrome on follow-up ('pure bvFTD'; AUC 0.78, 95% CI 0.63-0.94). In bvFTD, reduced insight was associated with salience and semantic appraisal network degeneration but not control frontotemporal regions. BvFTD, false-positives, and their informants demonstrated opposing patterns of symptom endorsement. Symptom under-endorsement (lack of insight) by patients relative to clinician and informant observation supports neurodegeneration, whereas informant and patient over-endorsement without clinician-observed disturbance suggests a false-positive. Unfamiliarity with bvFTD may contribute to over-reporting. Though the clinician-dependent findings may not translate to non-expert settings, the patient-informant model retained good discrimination. Formal quantification of discrepancy patterns in behaviour may reduce misdiagnosis in bvFTD. The neuroimaging findings support salience and semantic appraisal networks as the neuroanatomical basis for insight in bvFTD. Future studies should validate the FBI clinician version and examine factors underlying over-reporting by false-positives and their informants.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Epigenetic heterogeneity in breast tumours informs diagnosis and prognosis.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Noa Furth; Christina Riemenschneider; Yishai Arieli; Matan Avni; Michael-Yakov Povolotski; Hadas Yung; Shiri Karagach; Ofir Atrakchi
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Breast cancer, the most diagnosed cancer among women, is stratified by gene expression patterns into luminal and basal-like subtypes, and the latter is associated with worse prognosis1-3. Recent advances in single-cell technologies have underscored the presence of intratumour heterogeneity, which poses substantial challenges in cancer treatment and achieving long-term disease-free survival4-7. Here we extensively profile epigenetic heterogeneity in a cohort of treatment-naive human luminal tumours, which were obtained directly after surgical resection. By applying a single-cell epigenetic approach based on cytometry by time-of-flight, we identify a recurrent subpopulation of basal-like cells in luminal tumours with a conserved epigenetic signature across patients. These basal-like cells, also identified by deconvolution of whole-genome DNA methylation patterns, are characterized by high expression of aggressive oncogenic traits and downregulation of hormone receptor signalling. Direct comparison of single-cell proteomic and genomic profiling of monomethylation and trimethylation of histone 3 on lysine 4 revealed that these marks are key features associated with loss of luminal identity. Finally, we highlight the potential of concomitant single-molecule profiling of histone modifications on cell-free nucleosomes in blood as an epigenetic liquid biopsy approach for early diagnosis of breast cancer. Moreover, the epigenetic basal signature measured in blood is linked to prognosis, which enables the identification of patients at increased risk for disease relapse.

global_hot_topics.title: Mitochondrial protein import stress augments α-synuclein aggregation and neural damage.
global_hot_topics.authors: Liam P Coyne; Arnav Rana; Xiaowen Wang; Joseph Mauro; Sanaea Bhagwagar; Yumiko Umino; Eduardo C Solessio; Frank Middleton
global_hot_topics.abstract: Genetic and environmental factors are known to converge on mitochondria to cause Parkinson's disease. The underlying mechanism is incompletely understood. In addition to bioenergetic defects, nonbioenergetic pathways have been largely unexplored. Validating the nonbioenergetic mitochondrial stressors as independent pathogenic factors is challenging because most mouse models of mitochondrial stress are confounded by bioenergetic defects. Here, we show that expression of Ant1P.A114P,A123D, previously shown to cause mitochondrial protein import clogging in cultured human cells, does not affect the overall bioenergetic capacity, yet it induces proteostatic stress responses in the cytosol that suggests accumulation of unimported precursor proteins. In a Parkinson's disease model expressing α-synuclein (A53T), Ant1P.A114P,A123D increased the size of α-synuclein aggregates, increased aggregation of mitochondrial preproteins, heightened neuroinflammation, and worsened motor coordination defects. Importantly, we found no evidence of bioenergetic defects in either α-synuclein (A53T) or α-synuclein (A53T) + Ant1P.A114P,A123D mice. These data suggest that Ant1P.A114P,A123D likely induces mitochondrial protein import stress, and contributes to neural damage through cytosolic proteostatic stress and altered aggregation dynamics of neuropathogenic proteins independent of bioenergetics.

global_hot_topics.title: Time course of the placebo response and associated factors in clinical trials of biologic agents for ankylosing spondylitis.
global_hot_topics.authors: Ting Li; Shun Han; Rui Chen; Lujin Li; Bin Wu
global_hot_topics.abstract: AIMS: To characterize the time course and influencing factors of placebo response in randomized trials of biologic and targeted synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (tsDMARDs) for ankylosing spondylitis (AS). PATIENTS AND METHODS: We systematically searched major electronic databases (up to June 14, 2024) for randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trials of biologics or Janus kinase inhibitors in AS. Model-based meta-analysis with nonlinear mixed-effects modeling was conducted to pool placebo-arm ASAS20 (≥20% improvement by Assessment of SpondyloArthritis International Society criteria) and ASAS40 (≥40% improvement) response trajectories, using an exponential rise-to-maximum model with covariate screening and model validation. RESULTS: Thirty-eight trial arms from 36 trials (3046 placebo-treated participants) were included. The estimated maximum response (Pmax) was 31.1% for ASAS20 (90% of Pmax reached at 6.5 weeks) and 18.6% for ASAS40 (90% of Pmax reached at 17.0 weeks). ASAS20 Pmax increased by 2.7% per publication year. Smaller trials, no background therapy, lower male proportion, and lower baseline HLA-B27 positivity were associated with higher placebo response. CONCLUSIONS: The AS placebo response, particularly for ASAS20, shows a significant upward secular trend. This model provides a quantitative benchmark for trial design, anomalous placebo responses identification, and interpreting efficacy in trials lacking a concurrent placebo arm. Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is a long-term inflammatory disease that mainly affects the joints of the spine. To find out whether a new medicine works, researchers compare it with a placebo, a dummy treatment with no active drug. The difficulty is that people given a placebo often improve anyway, and by very different amounts from trial to trial. When the placebo response is unusually large, an effective medicine can look as though it does not work. We collected data from 38 published AS trials of biologic medicines or Janus kinase inhibitors, covering 3046 people who received a placebo. Using a mathematical model, we described how the placebo response changes with time and what makes it larger or smaller. Two findings stood out. First, the placebo response grows slowly and then levels off: it takes about 6.5 weeks to reach its maximum when improvement reaches 20% and about 17 weeks when it reaches a stricter 40%, so a trial that stops early may underestimate the placebo group’s improvement. Second, the placebo response has grown by about 2.7% a year since 2002. It also tends to be larger in smaller trials, in trials where background painkillers were not allowed, in trials with fewer men and in trials where fewer patients carried the human leukocyte antigen B27 (HLA-B27) gene. Our model is a reference point: it helps researchers judge whether a new trial’s placebo response is unusually large or small, and interpret trials that had no placebo group. It may help design smaller, faster trials.

global_hot_topics.abstract: AIMS: This study investigates the genotype and allele frequencies of solute carrier family 29 member 4 (SLC29A4) rs2685753 and serine/threonine kinase 11 (STK11) rs2301759 in the Saudi population and their association with metformin response in Saudi patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), while comparing the findings with other ethnic populations. PATIENTS & METHODS: A prospective cohort study included 69 newly diagnosed Saudi adults with T2DM receiving metformin monotherapy for at least six months and 59 healthy controls. Genotyping was performed using TaqMan single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) assays. Associations between genetic variants and glycemic response were analyzed using chi-square tests and logistic regression. RESULTS: Among patients, 55% achieved adequate glycemic control, whereas 45% were non-responders. SLC29A4 rs2685753 showed no significant association with the metformin response. In contrast, STK11 rs2301759 demonstrated significant genotypic and allelic associations, with the C/T genotype linked to improved glycemic response. Higher baseline glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) and family history of diabetes were associated with poorer response. CONCLUSION: STK11 rs2301759 may influence metformin efficacy in Saudi patients with T2DM and could support personalized diabetes management. Metformin is one of the most commonly used medicines for type 2 diabetes, but it does not work equally well for everyone. Differences in a person’s genes may partly explain why some people respond better to metformin than others. This study examined whether differences in two genes, called solute carrier family 29 member 4 (SLC29A4) and serine/threonine kinase 11 (STK11), were related to how well metformin-controlled blood sugar in Saudi patients with type 2 diabetes. The study included 69 Saudi patients with type 2 diabetes who received metformin treatment alone, along with 59 individuals with metformin alone and 59 people without diabetes for comparison. After six months of treatment, 55% of the patients achieved the target blood sugar level, while 45% did not. Differences in the SLC29A4 gene were not related to how well patients responded to metformin. However, differences in the STK11 gene were associated with treatment response. Blood sugar levels before treatment and a family history of diabetes were also related to how well patients responded. These findings suggest that genetic differences may help explain why metformin works better for some people than for others. Before genetic testing can guide metformin treatment in routine clinical practice, further studies with larger patient groups are necessary.

global_hot_topics.title: Transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block versus standard analgesia for postoperative pain following open upper abdominal surgery through a midline incision: a protocol for a prospective randomized controlled trial.
global_hot_topics.authors: Jihen Krichen; Asma Sghaier; Slah Soui; Sihem Sendi; Maroua Naoui; Bilel Faidi; Khalil Ben Salah; Amine Felhi
global_hot_topics.abstract: AIMS: To determine whether bilateral ultrasound-guided subcostal transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block, added to standardized non-opioid multimodal analgesia, reduces early pain after open upper midline laparotomy. PATIENTS AND METHODS: In this single-center, parallel-group randomized controlled superiority trial, 108 adults undergoing elective open upper abdominal surgery through a midline incision will be randomized 1:1 (stratified by procedure category) to TAP block (bupivacaine 0.25%, 30 mL per side, maximum 2.5 mg/kg) plus multimodal analgesia or multimodal analgesia alone. Outcome assessors and the statistician will be blinded; no sham block is used. The primary outcome is pain at rest on a 100-mm visual analog scale (VAS), averaged over 6, 12 and 24 h after surgery. Secondary outcomes include movement-evoked pain, Quality of Recovery-15 (QoR-15), consumption of each rescue analgesic, postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV), time to ambulation, time to first flatus and adverse events (actively monitored until 48 h after surgery or hospital discharge, whichever is later). PLANNED ANALYSIS: The primary effect will be estimated by intention-to-treat using a mixed model for repeated measures, as the equally weighted mean between-group difference with 95% confidence interval. CONCLUSION: This trial will quantify the incremental benefit of subcostal TAP block in a defined surgical population. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: Pan African Clinical Trials Registry (www.pactr.org) identifier is PACTR202608546707144. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Pan African Clinical Trials Registry (PACTR; www.pactr.org), PACTR202608546707144, registered on 18 August 2026. Operations on the upper part of the abdomen through a long vertical cut are painful. Pain can stop patients from breathing deeply, getting out of bed and walking, and can slow the return of normal bowel function. In our hospital, pain after such operations is usually treated with medicines given through a drip or an injection, such as paracetamol, nefopam and ketoprofen.A transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block is an injection of local anesthetic (numbing medicine) into a layer between the muscles of the abdominal wall. The anesthetist guides the needle with an ultrasound scanner while the patient is already asleep. The numbing medicine may reduce pain in the skin and muscles around the wound for several hours.This study will include 108 adults having planned surgery through an upper vertical cut. By chance, like tossing a coin, half will receive the TAP block on both sides in addition to usual pain medicines, and half will receive usual pain medicines only. The staff who ask patients about their pain will not know which group they are in. We will compare pain scores during the first day after surgery, pain when coughing, the amount of extra pain medicine needed, sickness, the time to first walking and to passing wind, overall recovery, and any side effects. The results will help doctors decide whether this block is worth adding to routine care after this type of operation.

global_hot_topics.title: PIKfyve inhibition induces LRRK2 activation through phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate and CASM.
global_hot_topics.authors: Tomoki Kuwahara; Gen Yoshii; Maria Sakurai; Shoichi Suenaga; Hiroki Nakanishi; Matthew Jefferson; Thomas Wileman; Kentaro Tomii
global_hot_topics.abstract: LRRK2 is a Parkinson's disease-associated kinase that phosphorylates Rab GTPases. Hyperactivation of LRRK2, which is thought to cause Parkinson's disease, occurs on stressed endolysosomal membranes via conjugation of ATG8 to single membranes (CASM) and Rab, whereas the involvement of specific membrane lipids remained unclear. Here, we found that the inhibition of PIKfyve that metabolizes phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) induces hyperactivation of LRRK2 and that additional inhibition of the class III phosphoinositide 3-kinase that generates PI3P suppressed LRRK2 hyperactivation. Cellular PI3P levels were indeed elevated when LRRK2 was activated. CASM-induced activation of LRRK2, but not CASM itself, was suppressed by phosphoinositide 3-kinase inhibitors, whereas inhibition of CASM or Rab12/Rab29 suppressed LRRK2 activation induced by PIKfyve inhibitors. LRRK2 and phospho-Rab10 were colocalized with PI3P on LAMP1-positive enlarged vacuoles, and LRRK2 directly bound PI3P in vitro via its N-terminal positively charged amino acids. Together, we propose an updated mechanism of LRRK2 hyperactivation that simultaneously requires CASM, Rab, and PI3P-rich membranes.

global_hot_topics.title: Extended DNA damage-induced G2/M arrests lead to aberrant mitoses through accumulation of securin.
global_hot_topics.authors: Anton Dubenko; Marah Jnied; Oleksii Kotenko; Svetlana Makovets
global_hot_topics.abstract: The stochastic nature of DNA damage dictates various scenarios of stress survival among different cells. We used time-lapse microscopy to perform single-cell level analyses of yeast populations with double-stranded DNA breaks and nonfunctional telomeres. Activation of the DNA damage signalling resulted in a broad distribution in the duration of G2/M arrests. Strikingly, the longer arrests correlated with aberrant mitoses caused by miscoordination of nuclear division and cytokinesis, leading to cell death. Chk1-dependent phosphorylation of Pds1 (securin), an inhibitor of sister chromatid separation in mitosis, was responsible for this phenomenon. Securin progressively accumulated during G2/M arrests, leading to grossly delayed or missed nuclear divisions. This phenotype could be suppressed by slowing down the progression of mitotic exit via LTE1 deletion or by lowering securin levels. Our results demonstrate that in cells taking too long to complete DNA repair, the DNA damage checkpoint promotes aberrant mitoses and cell death, thereby eliminating cells with a higher chance of genomic instability.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: DNA 损伤的随机性决定了不同细胞之间应激生存的各种情况。我们使用延时显微镜对具有双链 DNA 断裂和非功能端粒的酵母群体进行单细胞水平分析。 DNA 损伤信号的激活导致 G2/M 停滞持续时间的广泛分布。引人注目的是，较长的停滞与核分裂和胞质分裂失调引起的异常有丝分裂相关，从而导致细胞死亡。 Pds1（securin）的 Chk1 依赖性磷酸化是有丝分裂中姐妹染色单体分离的抑制剂，是造成这种现象的原因。 Securin 在 G2/M 逮捕期间逐渐积累，导致核分裂严重延迟或错过。这种表型可以通过 LTE1 缺失减慢有丝分裂退出的进程或降低 securin 水平来抑制。我们的结果表明，在需要很长时间才能完成 DNA 修复的细胞中，DNA 损伤检查点会促进异常有丝分裂和细胞死亡，从而消除基因组不稳定可能性较高的细胞。

global_hot_topics.authors: Huan Yang; Wei Chen; Lixiang Liu; Mengxiong Li; Wei Liao; Yunxia He; Ruohong Pan; Yaoyao Xu
global_hot_topics.abstract: Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN), a precursor of human papillomavirus (HPV)-driven cervical cancer, poses a severe threat to women's health. High-risk HPV infection drives CIN progression, whereas well-defined intervention targets and effective non-invasive therapies remain lacking. Herein, Using New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), specifically HPV16-positive ectocervical organoids as a human-relevant disease model, we evaluated the therapeutic potential of engineered cell-free small extracellular vesicles derived from human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells (hucMSC-sEV). We found that hucMSC-sEV significantly promoted squamous differentiation in S12 cells and HPV16-positive ectocervical organoids. Mechanistically, integrated multi-omics analyses within this NAMs platform revealed that hucMSC-sEV delivered ceramide synthase 1 (CERS1) to upregulate C18 ceramide (C18 Cer) synthesis, activating the non-canonical p53 signaling to drive squamous differentiation. In NCG mice bearing subcutaneous xenografts of S12 cells, hucMSC-sEV effectively inhibited S12 xenograft growth and modulated squamous differentiation via regulation of C18 ceramide metabolism, while this therapeutic effect was abrogated in CERS1-knockdown hucMSC-sEV. This study delineates the molecular mechanism by which hucMSC-sEV remodel sphingolipid metabolism to promote cervical squamous epithelial differentiation and suppress S12 xenograft development, providing novel potential targets and therapeutic strategies for CIN intervention.

global_hot_topics.title: Gene therapy for epilepsy: From
global_hot_topics.authors: Ruotong Qin; Xiaoge Hu; Wei Jiang; Jing Wang; Mei Zheng; Zhenqiang Zhang; Dongrui Ma
global_hot_topics.abstract: Genetic epilepsy, for which the molecular mechanisms are relatively well defined in numerous monogenic forms, represents an attractive model for the transition from symptomatic seizure control to mechanism‑driven correction. However, gene therapy strategies differ in their mechanisms of action, adaptability to specific mutations and translational maturity, making rational selection of interventions based on variant‑specific functional consequences an important clinical challenge. The present review examined five nucleic acid‑based therapeutic strategies, namely gene supplementation, enhancement of endogenous gene expression, gene silencing, DNA editing and RNA editing, for major causative genes, using mutation‑specific functional consequences [loss‑of‑function (LOF) vs. gain‑of‑function] as the primary framework for therapeutic decision‑making. The mechanisms and suitability of each approach are analysed, and their performance in terms of cell‑type specificity, delivery vectors and safety is evaluated by integrating evidence from animal models, induced pluripotent stem cell‑derived neurons and organoids and clinical trials. The present review also summarised key translational barriers, including vector cargo constraints, blood‑brain barrier penetration, off‑target and immune‑associated risks, therapeutic dosing windows and the timing of developmental intervention. Antisense oligonucleotides and regulatory adeno‑associated viral approaches, supported by mature delivery platforms and manageable safety profiles, have progressed furthest towards clinical validation. Endogenous gene activation strategies, such as CRISPR activation, offer a gene replacement‑free approach for LOF disorders but remain preclinical. DNA and RNA editing, while potentially capable of durable disease modification, require further evidence on delivery efficiency and long‑term homeostatic safety. Gene therapy for genetic epilepsy is undergoing a key transition from proof‑of‑concept studies to individualised clinical application. Future progress will depend on integrating personalised intervention design, multi‑target therapeutic combinations, artificial intelligence‑assisted sequence optimisation and standardised translational models, with the potential to drive a paradigm shift from seizure suppression to mechanistic correction.

medical_news.title: The brain’s hidden fear mechanism may explain anxiety and PTSD
medical_news.abstract: A surprising new discovery suggests that fear may cause the brain to blur the line between danger and safety rather than distinguish them more clearly. By observing brain activity in mice using augmented reality, scientists found that memories of threatening and harmless environments began to overlap, potentially allowing faster responses to danger. medical_news.title: Scientists wipe out deadly brain tumors in every mouse tested with new cancer therapy
medical_news.abstract: Scientists at UC San Francisco have developed a powerful new cancer therapy that remains inactive until it reaches the brain, where it switches on to attack deadly tumors. The engineered immune cells, called B-SYNC CAR-T cells, completely eliminated diffuse midline glioma (DMG), an aggressive childhood brain cancer that is almost always fatal within a year, in two mouse models.
